resources.string: Save a recovery link before removing the manager
Save the link before confirming. The manager will be uninstalled; pairing data is kept.
Copy or open the recovery link, save it somewhere you can find later, then confirm below.
I have saved the recovery link
The recovery link is not ready. Try again before enabling stealth.
Stealth did not finish. Check the connection and prepare a recovery link to try again.
The link was not copied. Try copying it again or open it in your browser.
The browser did not open. Copy the recovery link instead.
The manager is uninstalled and its pairing data is kept. Use your saved recovery link to manage MapleSU or restore the manager.
WebUI status has not been confirmed
Your recovery link will be paused. Pairing data, recovery backups and stealth state will be kept. Prepare the recovery link again when you need it.
Prepare and save the recovery link again to continue enabling stealth.
The WebUI has not been confirmed closed. Please try again.
Choose a port to start WebUI and prepare your recovery link.
